shown.means: the chapter the player is at (0 the prologue … 5 the epilogue, 6 the finale): the view goes to its point c<i> (camera_x)

come.means: each new value brings the view back to the chapter shown (camera_x), the player's drag with it

route.means: how far Papa's pencilled course has come across the sea: 0 none (the valley) … 1 at the island

prompts.text: Solo nylon-string guitar picking a slow, plain northern folk tune, close and intimate, sea wind behind it
Soft accordion holding long quiet chords, a little out of breath, a Finnish summer evening by the shore
Sparse felt piano, three notes and a long pause, cold clear morning air, gentle melancholy
A small clarinet melody, wistful and a little comic, like a story told to a child, over a bowed double bass
Glassy harmonium drones with the hiss of waves on granite, slow and wide, almost still
Music box playing a lullaby slightly out of tune, far away, nostalgic
Solo cello, long low phrases, lonely lighthouse at dawn, restrained and warm
Kantele plucked softly, open fifths, Nordic folk, bright and bare
Brushed snare and upright bass, a slow cheerful waltz, a family on a boat trip
Whistled melody over a ukulele, light-hearted, a proud father setting out on an adventure
Strings swelling slowly into a wide open chord, the sea and the sky, hopeful and sad at once
Wind chimes and low synth pad, the bare island at night, the moon on the water
Tin whistle and frame drum, a storm coming up over the sea, restless
A celesta and a flute, an imaginary garden painted on a wall, bees and summer warmth
Low drone of a foghorn-like brass note under thin high violins, a dark lighthouse, waiting
Children's choir humming wordlessly, very far off, a memory of a valley
